title: Biophilic Floating Staircase & Water Body
tagline: Cantilevered floating marble stairs integrated with living greenery courtyard & indoor water body
description: Transforming the transitional under-stair space into the artistic heart of the villa. Features natural stone cladding with up-facing spotlights, cantilevered steps, indoor palm planters, river pebbles, and an organic curved upholstered banquette seating lounge.
